fox.terms: Public ID list. Plugin author describes free-to-use findings; this does not establish rights to underlying assets. Names and Image type checked against official economy.roblox.com/v2/assets/ID/details; IsPublicDomain/creator retained as reported.

pew.author: pewpewagent (Pew)
pew.terms: Author-published open-source mesh flipbook pack. Extracted instance properties only; no module/source code or asset binaries bundled. Separate frame textures need custom mesh/decal animation, NOT a native particle grid.

bloxodes.terms: Public reference metadata only, first 120 listed mesh records, not the full 1000-item catalog. Creator Store wrapper IDs kept separate from underlying MeshId. Underlying rights/access not inferred.

roblox_creator_store.terms: Public Creator Store reference metadata only; no images/models/scripts distributed. Explicit textureId/meshId mappings from Roblox API, NOT listing IDs. Public listing or free price does not establish license or in-experience permissions. Delivery and appearance must be checked in Studio.

openvfx.terms: README permits using/adding/modifying library. No formal asset license supplied; underlying asset rights/access not verified.
